description: Figure and tables: overlap and spatial separation between the Arc N-lobe peptide pocket and the oligomerisation / CaMKII phospho surface
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("cwd:",os.getcwd())
OUT = "provenance" if os.path.isdir("provenance") else "."
if OUT==".":
    for cand in ("/agent/jobs/8702c639-95bf-4148-bbca-ab3e5442c5e6/provenance","/data/../provenance"):
        if os.path.isdir(cand): OUT=cand; break
print("writing CSVs to:",OUT)

POCK={"4X3H stargazin":{206,209,210,211,212,213,214,215,220,227,245,247,250,271,274,275},
      "4X3I CaMKIIa":{210,211,212,213,214,215,220,223,227,244,245,247,250,271},
      "6TNQ GKAP-R4":{211,212,213,214,215,220,227,244,245,247,249,250,271},
      "6TQ0 GKAP-R5":{212,213,214,215,220,223,227,244,245,246,247,249,250,271,274,275},
      "6TNO stargazin":{211,212,213,214,215,220,223,227,245,246,247,248,249,250,271,274,275}}
names=list(POCK); core=set.intersection(*POCK.values()); union=set().union(*POCK.values())
ZH={241,257,260,277,278,335}
# distances measured from 6GSE model 1 in the previous cell (CB-CB, CA for Gly)
DIST=pd.DataFrame({"resi":[241,257,260,277,278,335],"aa":list("QKSGTR"),
   "dist_to_pocket_centroid_A":[16.2,16.2,20.2,13.7,10.7,46.4],
   "min_dist_to_any_pocket_res_A":[5.3,7.8,11.5,6.4,5.8,36.4]})
DIST.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"arc_pocket_vs_oligomer_distances.csv"),index=False)
pd.DataFrame([dict(entry=k,n_pocket_res=len(v),residues=";".join(map(str,sorted(v))),
                   overlap_with_oligomer_surface=len(v&ZH)) for k,v in POCK.items()]
            ).to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"arc_nlobe_pocket_sets.csv"),index=False)
print("core pocket (all 5 ligands):",sorted(core))
print("union pocket:",sorted(union),"| overlap with {241,257,260,277,278,335}:",sorted(union&ZH))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,7.6),gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[1.3,1]))
a=ax[0]; ys=np.arange(len(names))[::-1]
for y,n in zip(ys,names):
    a.scatter(sorted(POCK[n]),[y]*len(POCK[n]),s=44,c="#2b6cb0",marker="s")
a.scatter(sorted(ZH),[len(names)-0.4]*len(ZH),s=52,c="#c53030",marker="D")
a.set_yticks(list(ys)+[len(names)-0.4]); a.set_yticklabels(names+["Zhang 2019 oligomer surface\nplus CaMKII sites S260, T278"],fontsize=9)
a.set_xlim(200,345); a.set_xlabel("Arc residue number"); a.grid(axis="x",alpha=0.25)
for r in sorted(core): a.axvline(r,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=0.10)
a.set_title("A. The N-lobe ligand pocket and the oligomerisation / phospho surface share no residue",fontsize=10)
b=ax[1]
b.bar(DIST.aa+DIST.resi.astype(str),DIST.min_dist_to_any_pocket_res_A,
      color=["#c53030" if r in (260,278) else "#718096" for r in DIST.resi])
b.axhline(8,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); b.text(0.01,8.5,"8 A side-chain contact range",fontsize=8,transform=b.get_yaxis_transform())
for i,v in enumerate(DIST.min_dist_to_any_pocket_res_A): b.text(i,v+0.7,f"{v:.1f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
b.set_ylim(0,42); b.set_ylabel("min CB-CB distance to\nany pocket residue (A)")
b.set_xlabel("oligomerisation residue (red = CaMKII phosphosite)")
b.set_title("B. Separation in the bilobar capsid domain, 6GSE rat Arc 206-364 model 1",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
